title: Email Experimentation
description: Design a rigorous email A/B test. Tests experimentation design, statistical reasoning, and marketing judgment.

seo.overviewBody: Email marketing remains the highest-ROI direct marketing channel. Employers evaluate candidates on building lifecycle email flows (Welcome Series, Abandoned Cart, Post-Purchase), A/B testing subject lines, optimizing open/click rates, and maintaining domain deliverability (SPF/DKIM/DMARC).

deliverables.title: 1. Automated Lifecycle Email Flow Blueprint
deliverables.desc: Flowchart mapping trigger rules, delay timers, branching logic, and goal criteria across subscriber journeys.

deliverables.title: 2. High-Converting Email Copy & HTML Templates
deliverables.desc: Email templates featuring persuasive copywriting, visual hierarchy, mobile responsiveness, and clear CTA buttons.

deliverables.title: 3. Subject Line A/B Test & Deliverability Log
deliverables.desc: Experimentation log documenting subject line test variants, open/click rate uplift, and domain deliverability status.

faqs.question: What are SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records?
faqs.answer: SPF verifies authorized sending servers, DKIM adds a cryptographic signature to emails, and DMARC tells receiving mail servers how to handle unauthenticated messages, preventing domain spoofing.

faqs.question: How do you optimize email subject lines for open rates?
faqs.answer: Keep subject lines under 50 characters, create curiosity or urgency without spam trigger words, incorporate preview text effectively, and test personalization tags.

faqs.question: What is an Abandoned Cart email flow?
faqs.answer: An automated series triggered when a logged-in user adds items to an e-commerce cart but exits before checkout, aimed at recovering lost revenue.
